subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: Should plugin-runtime session authority require exact pluginOwnerId equality for every sessions.create parent and target path, including rejection of legacy ownerless rows?
rationale: The patch closes a confidentiality boundary, but exact equality intentionally breaks any legacy plugin workflow whose rows lack trustworthy ownership provenance; the Gateway/security owner must confirm that fail-closed upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve exact equality
options.body: Land the fail-closed boundary after exact-head checks, treating legacy ownerless rows as operator-managed rather than adoptable by a plugin.

options.title: Consolidate first
options.body: Coordinate with the sessions.patch work so create, patch, and delete use one canonical authorization helper before either PR lands.

options.title: Pause for migration design
options.body: If ownerless plugin continuity is required, pause until a provenance-safe migration or explicit operator reassignment flow exists without permitting silent adoption.

recommendation.title: Approve exact equality
recommendation.body: Land the fail-closed boundary after exact-head checks, treating legacy ownerless rows as operator-managed rather than adoptable by a plugin.
